reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Cattitude! Taryn, the owner, responded quickly to my last-minute request (when we were using Cattitude for the first time) and was incredibly kind and accommodating. Their detailed intake process made it clear how much they care about providing the best possible care for each animal. Sabrina did an excellent job looking after my two cats, including administering medication to one of them. Their services are also affordable—I highly recommend them!

Complete peace of mind !!
Cate has taken care of my senior cat for the past 2 summers and I cannot begin to express how amazing she is and how grateful I am to have the peace of mind to leave my cat for a month in her and Taryn’s care.
They both go above and beyond and I am so thankful to have found them
Highly highly recommended!

I found Cattitude in the spring, while searching for a trusted cat sitter for the summer. I needed someone to take care of my two cats, so I could travel for a couple weeks.   I must say the whole process of working with Cattitude was professional and smooth.   I couldn't be happier with my experience.

I was fortunate enough to have Cate assigned to my cats as an overnight cat-sitter and she was fantastic.  She sent me photos every day of my cats and a little report of how the cats were doing.  She was very attentive and caring.  She made me feel at ease.   I will definitely use the Cattitude Service again.    Thanks Cattitude!!

Taryn at Catitude Street Strutters did a great job looking after my cat while I was away for a couple of weeks.

She was reliable, communicative, and sent regular updates with photos and videos, which I appreciated. My cat ended up having some stomach issues while I was gone, and Taryn kept me informed, cleaned everything up, and even picked up some food that helped get things back to normal before I got home.

It was clear she spent time with him during her visits, and I came home to a healthy cat and everything in good shape. Overall, a really positive experience, and I’d definitely recommend Catitude Street Strutters to anyone looking for a dependable cat sitter.

I've been using Cattitude Street Strutters for three years now to take care of my cat Jessie anytime I'm out of town for a long or short period. All of the sitters I've had experience with are outstanding, especially Susie who is the absolute best and takes such good care of my cat when I'm away. If any emergency pops up, they always make sure to have another member of the team come out so that my girl is always well taken care of no matter what. Can't say enough great things & am SO thankful to have to them.
Been using them for years with our house cats. Always communicating, putting us at ease with pics and notes while we're away on vacation. The best!!!

I’ve been a loyal Cattitude client for over five years and recommend them without reservation. They’ve taken outstanding care of my cat Beatrice whenever I’ve been out of town. I’ve used several of their sitters over the years, and I’ve only had positive experiences. I especially appreciate the pictures and daily updates. Taryn is also a very attentive owner with great customer service. Thank you for everything!
Excellent service! I have a senior kitty who needs special care and Cattitude Street Strutters has gone beyond my expectations!

We try not to spend too much time away from our little guy but life inevitably comes up. We’ve worked with Taryn and the team at Cattitude for several years now and have had nothing but positive experiences. Will never use another service in NYC.

We are so grateful for the Cattitude team and the amazing sitters who have gone above and beyond multiples instances to care for our cat, Hank.

Similarly to others here, we have also had bad experiences with Rover and wanted to have sitters from a local professional business that puts pets first. If you’re at all undecided about who to care for your pet, please let it be from a local, insured business that has a reputation to maintain. Rover is not that and will prioritize profits over people and pets.

Thank you Taryn, Johanna, and Doreen for loving and caring for Hank! We love Cattitude!
